articles.summary: STAMFORD, Conn., Jan. 30, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Star Group, L.P. (the “Company” or “Star”) (NYSE: SGU), a leading home energy distributor and services provider, today announced that it will release its fiscal 2026 first quarter results after the close of trading on February 4, 2026.
